positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Work on streaming query engine (Java) and ETL pipeline (Kotlin, Flink).
• Manager (first direct report in Feb 2026).
• As Technology Business Lead for 2026 Women in Tech and Trading program: managed one day of activities; gave constructive feedback to external partners for implementation.
• Serve as one of 5 members on the Chicago Sustainability Committee, tracking carbon emissions for our net-zero goals.
